As we can see in the clouds of @fig-reg-mindmap-7, we will review a significant number of regression models in this course. Of course, the statistical literature extends well beyond the models listed here. Regression analysis is a **broad and evolving field**, and more specialized or complex approaches may be needed to address particular research questions or data structures. Still, we view these as the core regression tools that every Data Scientist should be **comfortable using and interpreting in everyday practice**.
